_comment: Jinja-style {{var}} template for boto3 ec2.run_instances(**spec). The launcher's FleetManager._render_runspec(...) reads this file, str.replace's each placeholder, json.loads the result, and passes it to boto3 directly. NO Jinja runtime dep -- substitution is plain str.replace. Variables: {{instance_type}} (e.g. 'c7a.2xlarge'), {{ami_id}} (e.g. 'ami-07bd7300ab2800515'), {{az}} (one entry from config.aws.az_fallback, e.g. 'us-east-1a'), {{count}} (int, becomes both MinCount and MaxCount), {{user_data_b64}} (base64-encoded scripts/aws/user-data.worker.warm.sh). The _comment key is stripped before the spec is sent to AWS.
